title: Synthwave
look: Pink-to-purple gradients, a cyan neon edge, scanlines, a striped sun and a grid.

doc.essence: An 80s album cover: magenta-violet bodies edged in cyan neon over a striped sunset and a grid.
doc.notIt: Not neon (filled, sun and grid), not soft-gradient (neon palette, scanlines).
doc.colour: Each area blended towards magenta at the top and indigo at the bottom.
pitfalls: Scanlines dim everything a little: keep eyes bright.
